cells.gaps: No rule in force is found: in 2024 the UN disability committee said the new Act does not cover information in accessible formats (MUS-003). The AI Unit's statement on its May 2026 audit of its own website gives no findings beyond critical issues fixed, so no audit results are counted.
cells.note: In May 2026 the AI Unit of the ICT ministry offered accessibility tools on its government website, and in 2025 a sign language e-dictionary was launched with the social integration ministry. Stage 5 needs published audit results, and the unit's own statement gives none.
